name: EPIC 248863417
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 14, 10.4 solar radii and 1.11 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 2,421 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 14, give 1.11 solar masses and 10.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,912 K at its surface.
